description: 礦業及土石採取業、電力及燃氣供應業、用水供應及污染整治業場所單位數-按開業時期及細行業別分 [electricity and power and gas networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 行政院主計總處. 礦業及土石採取業、電力及燃氣供應業、用水供應及污染整治業場所單位數，並按開業時期(含民國34年以前、民國35~49年、民國50~59年、民國60~69年、民國70~79年、民國80~89年、民國90~99年、民國100~104年、民國105年、民國106年、民國107年、民國108年、民國109年、民國110年)及細行業別分. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 行政院主計總處. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2024-08-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
